We are seeking a talented Generative AI Engineer to join our innovative team
As a Generative AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge generative models to create new content and solve complex problems across various domains
You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, explore advanced AI techniques, and deliver impactful solutions that drive business value
Responsibilities:
Research, design, and implement generative models, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), and other deep learning architectures.
Develop algorithms and pipelines for generating high-quality content in areas such as image synthesis, text generation, music composition, or natural language processing.
Collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers, and domain experts to collect and preprocess data, train models, and evaluate performance.
Optimize and fine-tune generative models for efficiency, scalability, and robustness in real-world applications.
Stay up to date with the latest advancements in generative AI research, contribute to academic publications, and participate in knowledge sharing within the team.
Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to understand business needs, define project requirements, and deliver solutions that meet user expectations.
Participate in code reviews, documentation, and testing to ensure the quality and reliability of AI systems.
Requirements:
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. PhD is a plus.
Proven experience in developing generative models using deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras.
Strong understanding of machine learning principles, algorithms, and techniques, particularly in the field of generative modeling.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++, and experience with software development practices and version control systems.
Excellent problem-solving skills, creativity, and ability to think critically about complex problems.
Effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with cloud computing platforms (eg, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and distributed computing environments is a plus.
Prior experience in applying generative AI techniques to practical applications in industries such as gaming, entertainment, design, healthcare, or finance is preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

Work with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers) to develop, fine-tune, and integrate models into products.

Design and test prompts for various tasks (prompt engineering) to improve model outputs.

Support development and deployment of generative AI applications (text, code, or image generation).

Write Python code to build ML/AI pipelines, evaluate model performance, and preprocess data.

Collaborate with data engineers to prepare and manage datasets used for training and evaluation.

Monitor and test model performance in production environments.

Document technical work, including models, experiments, and results.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

0 1 year of industry experience in AI/ML, or a strong academic or project portfolio.

Proficient in Python and libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and matplotlib.

Basic understanding of machine learning workflows and model evaluation.

Exposure to LLMs (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Mistral) through personal or academic projects.

Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers or OpenAI API is a plus.

Basic understanding of data engineering concepts such as ETL, data cleaning, and pipeline orchestration.




As a Junior AI Engineer, youll be part of a fast-moving team working on developing and integrating LLMs and Generative AI tools into real-world applications. Youll contribute to model experimentation, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and data preparation while growing your understanding of how these technologies power modern software systems.

The Consumer Products Center of Expertise collaborates with Bains global Consumer Products Practice leadership, client-facing Bain leadership and teams, and end clients on the development and delivery of Bain’s proprietary CP products and solutions.

These solutions aim to answer strategic questions relating to brand strategy (consumer needs, assortment, pricing, distribution), revenue growth management (pricing strategy, promotions, profit pools, trade terms), negotiation strategy with key retailers, optimization of COGS, etc.




You will work as part of the team in CP CoE comprising a mix of Directors, Managers, Project Leads, Associates, and Analysts working to implement cloud-based end-to-end advanced analytics solutions.

Delivery models on projects vary from working as part of a CP Center of Expertise, broader global Bain case team within the CP ringfence, or within other industry CoEs such as FS, Retail, TMT, Energy, CME, etc., with BCN on a need basis.




About You

A Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Bachelor’s candidates with relevant industry experience will also be considered.
4–6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, and building and deploying production AI systems.
Hands-on experience designing agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or Azure AI Agent Service.
Experience developing LLM-powered applications and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with vector databases and embedding-based retrieval.
Working knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, Cypher) for knowledge graphs, entity modeling, and graph-based retrieval.
Proficiency in Python and building backend APIs (FastAPI/Django) to serve models and agents in production.
Hands-on experience deploying AI workloads on Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML) and cloud deployment best practices.
Solid grasp of prompt engineering, model evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and Git for MLOps/LLMOps workflows.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems and LLM-powered applications that automate complex analytical and business workflows for Consumer Products clients.
Develop and orchestrate multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, and Azure AI Agent Service, integrating tools, memory, and reasoning loops.

Build and maintain MLOps/LLMOps pipelines using Docker, CI/CD, and Git for continuous deployment and monitoring of AI services.

The Senior Associate is expected to have a knack for seeking out challenging problems and producing their own ideas, which they will be encouraged to brainstorm with their peers and managers.
They should be willing to learn new techniques and be open to solving problems with an interdisciplinary approach.
They must have excellent coding skills and should demonstrate a willingness to write modular, reusable, and functional code.
